building.neighborhoodDescription: The 22203 area boasts a vibrant lifestyle with a rich mix of urban energy and green spaces. Residents enjoy easy access to numerous parks like the nearby Bon Air Park, perfect for outdoor activities and family outings. The neighborhood features a thriving dining scene, with a variety of restaurants offering diverse culinary options, and a strong coffee culture highlighted by local cafes. With a median rent of approximately $2,500, the rental price range typically falls between $1,800 and $3,200, making it an appealing choice for those seeking convenience and community.

neighborhoodHighlights.name: Dining Scene
neighborhoodHighlights.description: A diverse array of restaurants and eateries cater to food lovers, showcasing both local and international cuisines.

neighborhoodHighlights.name: Family Vibes
neighborhoodHighlights.description: Family-friendly parks and recreational facilities make this neighborhood a welcoming place for families.

neighborhoodHighlights.name: Green Spaces
neighborhoodHighlights.description: Well-maintained parks and green areas provide residents with plenty of places to relax and enjoy nature.

building.description:
AVA Ballston Square in Arlington, Virginia is perfectly located. Now offering one and two bedroom furnished and unfurnished Arlington apartments.

AVA Ballston Square in Arlington, Virginia is perfectly located. Now offering one and two bedroom furnished and unfurnished Arlington apartments. Our Furnished+ homes come outfitted with essential stylish furniture plus all utilities, including cable and Wi-Fi, are included in the rent. Only a few blocks from the Ballston and Virginia Square (Orange and Silver Line) Metro stations, AVA Ballston Square offers amenities including a courtyard with pool, grills, indoor and outdoor lounges, fitness center, and co-work lounge.
